title: France — Gilets Jaunes 2018-19
description: Movimiento de protesta espontáneo contra alza de combustibles. Sin líderes formales, organización via Facebook. 300k manifestantes semana 1.
sources: IFOP polling: soutien aux Gilets Jaunes (Nov 2018)
data_notes: P represents protest_support_index (units: index). Series reconstructed from published research sources (empirical_estimated). Observation operator H: fraction(|opinion| > 0.3). At Tier 1 (< 500 observations), only aggregate parameters can be calibrated against this case; see docs/validation/PROMPT_CALIBRACION_EQUIPO_AGENTES.md.
observation_operator_description: Protest support index: P reflects the share of population strongly mobilized. Observation operator H: fraction of agents with |opinion| > 0.3 (engagement threshold).
